title: Filter
subtitle: Phase-locked doors: only matching echoes pass.

?.name: filter
?.description: Passes echoes whose arrival direction matches the filter's phase; consumes the rest.

router.note: Route the two echoes; one is a decoy for the filter.

hints: A filter's rewrite is: A@dir -> A, dir  |  A@!dir -> ∅
Phase equals arrival direction. N and S are opposites; E and W are opposites.
Only one of the two echoes needs to reach the goal. The other is your key.
intro: Both filters here pass north-bound echoes and consume east-bound ones. Only one of your two sources should reach the goal.
